notes.title: Update 1.9 - Hookah Cafe Simulator
notes.content:
"Dive into the exciting world of Hookah Cafe Simulator with our latest update, version 1.9! We've added a sultry new dancer to the VIP table, enhanced tasks for more fun, introduced a handy hints section, opened up a yard sale for selling second-hand objects, and tantalized your taste buds with fresh tobacco flavors. Get ready for an even more immersive experience!"

New Features:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750870/a408dedd585be954ad1a93831867fa6ce245a8c7.jpg[/img]
Yard Sale Stand: Set up your very own marketplace to sell second-hand objects and turn your clutter into cash. Keep your cafe stylish and pocket some extra coins!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750870/5b99ab8d8fc8bc4156c60b7329ba11ea87a93385.png[/img]
Latin Royalty Sofa:The Latin Royalty Sofa will add a touch of class to your cafe. With the sumptuous Latin Royalty Sofa, you may attract even more customers! This lavish addition not only increases tips but also captivates your guests with a spectacular dance performance by a skilled dancer."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750870/c4f58b3e2899427b9954eb4e12e06ef18f98f123.png[/img]
Discover New Flavors: Delight customers with unique tobacco options, attracting more visitors to your shop. Find hidden origami around the city to unlock fresh flavors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750870/5137b4ba39a07d8e6b4620db0dae5a23ac478c96.png[/img]
Hints Section: Stuck? No problem! Check out our new Hints Section for guidance when you need it. Keep the excitement alive in your Hookah Cafe adventure.

Enhanced Tutorials: Enjoy smoother gameplay with our improved tutorials, making your Hookah Cafe adventure even more user-friendly.

Bug Fixes and Improved Lighting: We've fixed minor bugs and brightened up the environment for an enhanced Hookah Cafe experience.


Immerse yourself in an exciting and dynamic experience like never before with Hookah Cafe Simulator version 1.9. Keep your café running well, deal with rowdy customers, and keep ahead of the competition. We appreciate your continuing support and can't wait to watch you thrive in this exciting new upgrade.

Discord: https://discord.gg/Fue8XtE

notes.title: New Bum Update
notes.content:
Update 1.8 - Hookah Cafe Simulator

Step into the thrilling world of Hookah Cafe Simulator with our latest update, version 1.8! Brace yourself for an even more immersive and action-packed experience as we introduce exciting new features, challenges, and characters to keep you on your toes.

New Features:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750870/f1841c517dc16edf85fdbb774315a9328fa0137b.jpg[/img]
Repair Booth: Where you can fix damaged objects and maintain a welcoming ambiance for your customers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750870/b804ff202c10539604fa93ebdbad85aa071f4748.jpg[/img]
Unwanted Guests: Be prepared to face unwelcome intruders who might disrupt your peaceful atmosphere. Drunk Man, Pervert Man, and Seller Man are now causing a ruckus in your café. Defend your business by ensuring that they stay away!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750870/d8d2c9bc0eda325ca1401dc7299d68feca09ae35.jpg[/img]
The Cleaner: Hire a new employee, the Cleaner, to keep your floors spotless.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750870/23f9be3da48cd084900b3bdc409cd3cfbd47faac.jpg[/img]
New Hookah Varieties: Surprise your customers with two unique hookah designs! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750870/434e4812eaa5acc5be20aa4d72762f81013a9719.jpg[/img]
King Sofa: Attract even more customers with the luxurious King Sofa! This opulent addition not only brings in more tips but also mesmerizes your guests with a captivating dance performance by a skilled belly dancer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750870/8e9fff3450d18fbf40ce8380c5bc381f76e425bf.jpg[/img]
Beating Mechanic: As the owner, you're now equipped to protect your business from thieves and unruly customers. Engage in a new beating mechanic to reclaim stolen money from the misbehaving customers. Show them who's in charge and keep your profits secure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750870/7bdfd48bb4769a58a3603af42cff628bc0e28296.jpg[/img]
Enhanced Customer Animations: Watch your customers react to different situations with brand-new animations, like running away when,clapping etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750870/e338a39d3f59330255f06f838c704430da630e57.jpg[/img]
Updated Sound Effects: We've revamped the sound effects for customers and other NPC characters! Enjoy an even more immersive experience with realistic and dynamic audio that brings your hookah cafe to life

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40750870/aef1ca64b94f8f4bd398c8d57cc4994fd936787d.jpg[/img]
Upcoming Rival Hookah Café: A new challenge is on the horizon! You will soon have the chance to face off against a rival hookah cafe in an upcoming version. Prepare yourself to showcase your business acumen, strategic skills, and dedication to claim the title of the best hookah cafe in town!

With Hookah Cafe Simulator version 1.8, immerse yourself in an engaging and dynamic experience like never before. Manage your café efficiently, deal with unruly guests, and stay ahead of the competition. Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait to see you thrive in this thrilling new update.
Discord: https://discord.gg/Fue8XtE

Customers' bugs have been fixed.
Waiter-related problems have been addressed.
Minor issues reported by players have been fixed.

We appreciate your support and feedback, which have helped us identify and address these issues. We hope this patch update provides a smoother and more enjoyable experience for all players. Thank you for playing our game!
